bug: Channel 3's older input delay advances only when the current input is nonzero.
trigger: A zero in_3 sample occurs when the prior x_3_0 differs from x_3_1—for example, after a nonzero sample followed by zero—and a later valid filter computation uses the input history.
effect: The stale x_3_1 value changes the channel 3 feed-forward result relative to the correctly shifted history.
